description: Send requests, run collections in the Test Explorer, and lint and scan Gostman API collections from VS Code.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Running a collection sends requests and runs its scripts.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: The extension starts the Gostman command line, which reads the collection from a local folder.
command.runFolder: Gostman: Run a folder of the collection
command.scan: Gostman: Scan the collection for leaked secrets
command.init: Gostman: Create a collection in this folder
config.path: Command that starts the Gostman CLI. Use a full path when `gostman` is not on the PATH.
config.environment: Environment name passed as `--env`. Empty uses the first environment of the collection. **Gostman: Select environment** and the status bar item change it.
